sentences.en: The Trump administration seems willing to let the prince have plenty of leeway.

sentences.en: And why would that be, though?
sentences.zh: 但这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: You said earlier that the reason President Trump has bet on MBS is that he provides the justification for the relationship.
sentences.zh: 你之前说过，特朗普总统押注穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的原因是他为这种关系提供了正当理由。

sentences.en: He is the best possible face for all the flaws and messiness of the Saudi Arabian United States alliance.
sentences.zh: 他是沙特阿拉伯与美国联盟所有缺陷和混乱的最好门面。

sentences.en: But in these actions, he seems to be emerging as a figure that would embarrass the United States.
sentences.zh: 但在这些行动中，他似乎正在成为一个让美国感到尴尬的人物。

sentences.en: So why would President Trump not attempt to exercise greater influence over his hand-picked leader of Saudi Arabia after this series of events?

sentences.en: I think President Trump would argue that Mohammed bin Salman needs the opportunity to establish himself, to consolidate power.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普总统会辩称，穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼需要机会来确立自己的地位，巩固权力。

sentences.en: He's operating in a tough part of the world.
sentences.zh: 他身处世界上一个艰难的地区。

sentences.en: But above all, I think the case he would make is that on the ultimate strategic issue of combating
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，我认为他会提出的理由是，在打击伊朗这一终极战略问题上，

sentences.en: Iran, which is the centerpiece of President Trump's Middle East strategy, Mohammed bin Salman is a critical player.
sentences.zh: 伊朗是特朗普总统中东战略的核心，而穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼是一个关键角色。

sentences.en: Remember, in Yemen, Saudi Arabia is fighting the Houthi rebels.
sentences.zh: 记住，在也门，沙特阿拉伯正在与胡塞武装作战。

sentences.en: The Houthis are backed by Iran.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装背后有伊朗支持。

sentences.en: So it's important in the fight against Iranian proxies in the region to have Saudi Arabia's support.
sentences.zh: 因此，在打击该地区的伊朗代理人时，获得沙特阿拉伯的支持非常重要。

sentences.en: And so to the extent that Iran is really the big prize for President
sentences.zh: 所以，就伊朗确实是特朗普总统眼中的大奖而言，

sentences.en: Trump, Mohammed bin Salman is his wingman in that effort.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼是他在这项努力中的僚机。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what's the message that this inaction by President Trump sends to Mohammed bin Salman
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普总统的这种不作为向穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼传递了什么信息，

sentences.en: if he knows that so long as Iran's being taken care of, everything else will more or less be forgiven?
sentences.zh: 如果他知道只要伊朗问题得到解决，其他一切或多或少都会被原谅？

sentences.en: Well, the message is that he has a free hand to do whatever he wants.
sentences.zh: 嗯，传递的信息就是他可以随心所欲地行事。

sentences.en: And that is above all the message that MBS has taken for the last 12 months.
sentences.zh: 而这正是过去12个月里穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼所接收到的最主要的信息。

sentences.en: And that brings us to October 2nd, when Jamal Khashoggi, a dissident Saudi journalist, enters the Saudi consulate in Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了10月2日，当时持不同政见的沙特记者贾迈勒·卡舒吉进入了沙特驻伊斯坦布尔领事馆。

sentences.en: The 59-year-old journalist went to the consulate with his Turkish fiance to get documents for their upcoming marriage.
sentences.zh: 这位59岁的记者和他的土耳其未婚妻一起去了领事馆，为他们即将举行的婚礼获取文件。

sentences.en: The fiance waited outside for five hours until finally calling police.
sentences.zh: 未婚妻在外面等了五个小时，直到最后报警。

sentences.en: Jamal Khashoggi never comes out of the Saudi consulate.
sentences.zh: 贾迈勒·卡舒吉再也没有从沙特领事馆出来。

sentences.en: And what we know now is that when he went inside...
sentences.zh: 而我们现在知道的是，当他进去的时候……

sentences.en: Khashoggi was murdered inside the consulate, allegedly by a 15-man Saudi team that arrived that day and left Turkey in the evening.
sentences.zh: 卡舒吉在领事馆内被谋杀，据称是由一个15人的沙特小组所为，他们当天抵达，晚上就离开了土耳其。

sentences.en: He was met by 15 operatives who had been sent from Saudi Arabia with the purpose of
sentences.zh: 他遇到了15名从沙特阿拉伯派来的特工，他们的目的是

sentences.en: interrogating him and perhaps renditioning back to Saudi Arabia, or perhaps simply to kill him and
sentences.zh: 审讯他，也许是将他引渡回沙特阿拉伯，或者也许只是为了杀掉他并

sentences.en: dismember him, which they did with a bone saw that one of the group had brought with them.
sentences.zh: 将他分尸，他们确实用其中一人带来的骨锯做了这件事。

sentences.en: And his body was taken out of the Saudi consulate in pieces in a crime that has riveted the entire world.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体被分块运出了沙特领事馆，这起罪行震惊了全世界。

sentences.en: From everything you've told us so far, Mark, President Trump would seem very reluctant to intervene here
sentences.zh: 马克，从你目前告诉我们的一切来看，特朗普总统似乎非常不愿在这里干预

sentences.en: against Saudi Arabia, even over an incident as grotesque and horrifying as this one.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯，即使是面对像这样怪诞和恐怖的事件。

sentences.en: So how does the president respond in the immediate aftermath of this?
sentences.zh: 那么总统在事发后的第一时间是如何回应的呢？

sentences.en: So his immediate inclination is to give Mohammed bin Salman and the Saudis the benefit of the doubt.
sentences.zh: 所以他最初的倾向是给穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼和沙特人留有余地。

sentences.en: He says, I just spoke with the king of Saudi Arabia.

sentences.en: He didn't really know.
sentences.zh: 他真的不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe...
sentences.zh: 也许……

sentences.en: I don't want to get into his mind, but it sounded to me like maybe these could have been rogue killers.
sentences.zh: 我不想揣测他的想法，但听起来可能这些人是流氓杀手。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: They tell me they had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我他们与此事无关。

sentences.en: Later, he acknowledges, well...
sentences.zh: 后来，他承认，嗯……

sentences.en: It'll have to be very severe.
sentences.zh: 那将必须是非常严厉的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's bad, bad stuff.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是非常糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: But we'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 但我们会看看发生什么。

sentences.en: If this is true, it would be serious.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，那将是严重的。

sentences.en: There might be serious consequences.
sentences.zh: 可能会有严重的后果。

sentences.en: And then he switches yet again and says, well, the intelligence I'm getting on this seems pretty persuasive.
sentences.zh: 然后他又一次转变态度说，嗯，我得到的关于此事的简报似乎相当有说服力。

sentences.en: And we now know that that intelligence makes a very strong, if circumstantial case, that very senior people in the Saudi royal court ordered this killing.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，这些情报提供了一个非常有力的、尽管是间接的证据，证明沙特王室的高层下令进行了这次杀戮。

sentences.en: So the president goes through this evolution of reactions right up until we see him,
sentences.zh: 所以总统经历了这一系列的反应演变，直到我们看到他，

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman, Michael Schmidt, and myself, go in to see him in the Oval Office last Thursday, and he's extremely circumspect on the case.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼、迈克尔·施密特和我，上周四去椭圆形办公室见他，他对这个案子极其谨慎。

sentences.en: He clearly knows a great deal now about what happened in that consulate.
sentences.zh: 他显然现在非常清楚领事馆里发生了什么。

sentences.en: But he stopped short of saying that he thinks Mohammed bin Salman could have played a role in it.
sentences.zh: 但他没有说他认为穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼可能在其中扮演了角色。

sentences.en: But he does also acknowledge this is a moment that has captured the imagination of the world, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 但他确实也承认，不幸的是，这是一个引起全世界关注的时刻。

sentences.en: So in that last word, unfortunately, you sensed for him the personal stakes.
sentences.zh: 所以从最后那个词“不幸的是”，你感觉到了对他个人的利害关系。

sentences.en: And so I do think he recognizes it.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为他意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: He's puzzling through it.
sentences.zh: 他正在苦苦思索。

sentences.en: He doesn't seem to have an easy answer.
sentences.zh: 他似乎没有简单的答案。

sentences.en: And he sees it as a situation replete with risk.
sentences.zh: 他认为这是一个充满风险的情况。

sentences.en: You almost sense that the president wishes that the world wouldn't pay so much attention to this as they hadn't these past episodes relating to Saudi Arabia,
sentences.zh: 你几乎感觉到总统希望世界不要像过去对待沙特阿拉伯的相关事件那样，对这件事给予如此多的关注，

sentences.en: that he would have preferred for everyone to have kind of swept this one under the rug and maintained the image of MBS as a reform minded leader.
sentences.zh: 他更希望每个人都能把这件事掩盖过去，并维持穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼作为改革派领导人的形象。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: I think that President Trump views this incident less as a human rights atrocity, less as something he needs to stand against than as a public relations problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普总统看待这起事件，与其说是一起侵犯人权的暴行，不如说是一个公关问题，而不是他需要站出来反对的事情。

sentences.en: He sees it as fundamentally something that is tarnishing the image of his ally.
sentences.zh: 他从根本上认为这正在玷污他盟友的形象。

sentences.en: I think he would have gladly moved on and brushed it under the rug.
sentences.zh: 我想他本来会很高兴地继续前进，把这件事掩盖过去。

sentences.en: He recognizes, however, that the circumstances of it make that impossible.
sentences.zh: 然而，他意识到这种情况使得这变得不可能。

sentences.en: Sadly, the victims of the airstrikes in Yemen are for the most part invisible to the WeSt. I think everyone can visualize the idea of a man walking
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，也门空袭的受害者对西方来说大部分是隐形的。我想每个人都能想象一个人走进

sentences.en: into a consulate and being cut up with a bone saw.
sentences.zh: 领事馆并被用骨锯肢解的画面。

sentences.en: There's something so visceral and dramatic and horrifying about that image that I think that has made it much harder for President Trump to simply wish it away.
sentences.zh: 那个画面有一种如此直观、戏剧性和恐怖的东西，我认为这使得特朗普总统很难简单地将其抛之脑后。

sentences.en: This is not going to be wished away.
sentences.zh: 这件事不会被轻易遗忘。

sentences.en: It's simply too appalling for people that it can be dismissed that easily.
sentences.zh: 它对人们来说太令人震惊了，不可能那么轻易地被忽视。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So the kind of cover story of MBS as a reformer was blown by the absolute horrificness of this particular act in a way that even a massive military intervention in Yemen
sentences.zh: 所以，穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼作为改革者的掩护故事，被这一特定行为的绝对恐怖性所打破，其程度甚至连在也门的大规模军事干预

sentences.en: couldn't achieve.
sentences.zh: 都无法达到。

sentences.en: I think the incredible drama of it had the effect, if you will, of ripping the mask off.
sentences.zh: 我认为它令人难以置信的戏剧性，如果可以这样说的话，起到了撕下假面具的作用。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Mohammed bin Salman, or at least Mohammed bin Salman's regime, is revealed to be murderous thugs.
sentences.zh: 突然间，穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼，或者至少是穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的政权，被揭露为杀人暴徒。

sentences.en: I wonder, Mark, if given the history that you outlined earlier of the role that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 马克，我想知道，考虑到你之前概述的美国，

sentences.en: and President Trump in particular played in recruiting Mohammed bin Salman to lead Saudi Arabia
sentences.zh: 特别是特朗普总统在招募穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼领导沙特阿拉伯方面所扮演的角色，

sentences.en: and finding ways to condone or ignore his behavior in places like Yemen and Lebanon, are we complicit in the death of Jamal Khashoggi?
sentences.zh: 以及寻找方法去宽恕或忽视他在也门和黎巴嫩等地的行为，我们是否是贾迈勒·卡舒吉之死的共犯？

sentences.en: Well, that's a question that's been asked of the administration in recent days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是最近几天人们向政府提出的一个问题。

sentences.en: And typically, the answer officials give is to react with incredulity.
sentences.zh: 通常，官员给出的回答是表现出怀疑。

sentences.en: How could you possibly suggest it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能这样暗示呢？

sentences.en: And yet, I think if we're going to be honest, you'd have to say that if you look at
sentences.zh: 然而，我认为如果我们诚实的话，你不得不说，如果你看看

sentences.en: the pattern of behavior over the past year, every single step of the way that Mohammed bin Salman has
sentences.zh: 过去一年的行为模式，穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼所做的每一件事，

sentences.en: done something, President Trump has not stopped him, has not stood up to say enough.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统都没有阻止他，没有站出来说“够了”。

sentences.en: There has never been a moment where President Trump has stepped up to curb MBS's behavior.
sentences.zh: 从来没有一个时刻，特朗普总统站出来遏制穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的行为。

sentences.en: So, in the case of eliminating a pesky journalist, it's plausible to ask, if you're MBS, why would you think that was going to be a problem either?
sentences.zh: 所以，在消灭一个讨厌的记者这件事上，如果你是穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼，问问自己为什么会认为这也会成为一个问题，是合理的。

sentences.en: Nothing else has proven to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 其他任何事情都没有被证明是一个问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Why would that be the tripwire?
sentences.zh: 为什么这会成为触发点呢？

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Mark, does it feel like Mohammed bin Salman and those around him have finally done something so egregious that the United States and President Trump cannot back him any longer?
sentences.zh: 马克，穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼和他周围的人是否终于做了一些如此令人发指的事情，以至于美国和特朗普总统再也无法支持他了？

sentences.en: I think that will partly depend on whether further evidence comes out, particularly if audio or video evidence of the crime itself is released by Turkey.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在一定程度上取决于是否有进一步的证据出现，特别是如果土耳其公布了犯罪本身的音频或视频证据。

sentences.en: That could make the situation untenable for Mohammed bin Salman.
sentences.zh: 那可能会使穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的处境变得站不住脚。

sentences.en: But I think it's important to note that there really isn't another good alternative right now in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 但我认为重要的是要注意，目前在沙特阿拉伯确实没有其他好的选择。

sentences.en: MBS has simply amassed so much power.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼积累了太多的权力。

sentences.en: It's not as though there's an obvious rival standing in the wings.
sentences.zh: 并不是说有一个明显的竞争对手在幕后等待。

sentences.en: There's not an easy substitution they could make at this point.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，他们没有可以轻易进行的替代方案。

sentences.en: MBS, to some extent, is someone they've gone all in on in Saudi Arabia, just as the United States has gone all in on MBS.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼在某种程度上是他们在沙特阿拉伯全力支持的人，就像美国全力支持穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼一样。

sentences.en: And so to some extent, the lack of alternatives is a product of our own aggressive cultivation of MBS.
sentences.zh: 因此，在某种程度上，缺乏替代方案是我们自己积极培养穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的结果。

sentences.en: So just so I'm clear, the United States has helped create the situation in which by helping
sentences.zh: 所以为了明确起见，美国通过帮助

sentences.en: to choose Mohammed bin Salman a year or so ago, we've left no real possibility for any rival power to emerge.
sentences.zh: 选择穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼，帮助创造了这种情况，我们没有留下任何真正的可能性让任何竞争对手出现。

sentences.en: And we now fear what would happen in a world in which MBS doesn't lead Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在担心如果穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼不领导沙特阿拉伯，世界会发生什么。

sentences.en: So in a very real way, we've created this entire situation from start to finish.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种非常现实的角度来看，我们从头到尾创造了整个局面。

sentences.en: And now we're stuck with the man who may be behind this absolutely horrible assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们被困在了那个可能策划了贾迈勒·卡舒吉这起极其可怕的暗杀事件的人身上。

sentences.en: And not just stuck with him for some period of time, stuck with him for decades.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是被困住一段时间，而是被困住几十年。

sentences.en: This is a young man who could be the king of Saudi Arabia for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可能在沙特阿拉伯当40年国王的年轻人。

sentences.en: So we have really locked in a very, very difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实陷入了一个非常、非常困难的境地。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mark.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，马克。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We have to be able to work with our allies.
sentences.zh: 我们必须能够与我们的盟友合作。

sentences.en: And Saudi Arabia has been, I think, a very strong ally in terms of pushing back against Iran's aggression,
sentences.zh: 我认为沙特阿拉伯在反击伊朗的侵略方面一直是一个非常强大的盟友，

sentences.en: which is funding a lot of terror in the region, whether it's the Houthis in Yemen or it's Hezbollah or Hamas.
sentences.zh: 伊朗正在资助该地区的许多恐怖活动，无论是也门的胡塞武装，还是真主党或哈马斯。

sentences.en: On Monday, during a rare televised interview with CNN, Jared Kushner defended the Trump administration's alliance with Mohammed bin Salman.
sentences.zh: 周一，在接受CNN罕见的电视采访时，贾里德·库什纳为特朗普政府与穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼的联盟进行了辩护。

sentences.en: The region, the Middle East, is a rough place.
sentences.zh: 该地区，中东，是一个艰难的地方。

sentences.en: It's been a rough place for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 它作为一个艰难的地方已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: And we have to be able to pursue our strategic objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们必须能够追求我们的战略目标。

sentences.en: But we also have to deal with, obviously, what seems to be a terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 但我们也必须处理显然看起来非常糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: Asked if bin Salman's government has tried to deceive the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当被问及本·萨勒曼政府是否试图欺骗美国

sentences.en: about its role in the murder of Jamal Khashoggi, Kushner declined to directly answer.
sentences.zh: 关于其在贾迈勒·卡舒吉谋杀案中的角色时，库什纳拒绝直接回答。

sentences.en: I see things that are deceptive every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都能看到欺骗性的事情。

sentences.en: I see them in the Middle EaSt. I see them in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我在中东看到了。我在华盛顿看到了。

sentences.en: And I think that we have our eyes wide open.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们睁大了眼睛。

sentences.en: I think that the president is focused on what's good for America.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统专注于对美国有利的事情。

sentences.en: What are our strategic interests?
sentences.zh: 我们的战略利益是什么？

sentences.en: You know, where do we share interests with other countries?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在哪些方面与其他国家有共同利益？

sentences.en: Let's work towards those.
sentences.zh: 让我们朝着这些目标努力。

sentences.en: But yeah, every day.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，每天都是如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间去深入了解付费墙后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the Trump administration is exploring a new alternative to separating migrant children from their parents
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，特朗普政府正在探索一种新的替代方案，以取代将移民儿童与父母分开的做法，

sentences.en: as it seeks to deter Central American families from illegally crossing the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为它试图阻止中美洲家庭非法越过美国

sentences.en: border.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: The plan, still under consideration, would force parents to choose between voluntarily giving up their children to foster care or remaining imprisoned together as a family.
sentences.zh: 该计划仍在考虑中，将迫使父母在自愿放弃孩子进入寄养系统或作为家庭继续一起被监禁之间做出选择。

sentences.en: The administration is determined to end the surge in family border crossings, which has resulted in more than 100,000 arrests in the last year.
sentences.zh: 政府决心结束家庭越境激增的局面，这在过去一年中导致了超过10万次逮捕。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter》

sentences.en: Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 节目中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean, do they black out to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝断片儿了才睡着的人。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏症或食物不耐受的情况？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
